notes.title: Deep Sleep: Labyrinth of the Forsaken - Now Available + Bundle!
notes.notes:
[p][i]Deep Sleep: Labyrinth of the Forsaken[/i] is out now!

In [i]Deep Sleep: Labyrinth of the Forsaken[/i], you’ll guide Amy through shifting dreamscapes where you can reshape her surroundings to solve puzzles and survive. Explore nightmarish, otherworldly environments with randomized elements, improve and unlock skills to strengthen Amy, and face strange beings whose intentions may blur the line between friend and foe. With multiple endings, hidden secrets, and an original soundtrack by Christopher Carlone, every run offers new dangers and new discoveries. [/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868360/Deep_Sleep_Labyrinth_of_the_Forsaken/"][/dynamiclink]This brand-new entry expands the shared universe of scriptwelder’s games, building on the mystery and atmosphere players know and love. Pick up one of the Bundles for a 10% or 15% discount! and use your savings on an extra cup of coffee; you won't want to sleep again; after you go Deep into the Labyrinth of the Forsaken!    [/p]

notes.title: Introducing Deep Sleep: Labyrinth of the Forsaken - coming this year!
notes.notes:
Have you been missing your time in the Sidereal Plexus Universe?  Have you been lucid dreaming again and need to wake up from the nightmares?  Well, do we have some great news for you!  

[h3]Deep Sleep: Labyrinth of the Forsaken takes you back into your dreams on an all-new point and click adventure from scriptwelder.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35974395/7da9c4946527684cb06907243524b56a7244d509.gif[/img]

Take on the role of Amy, as you solve puzzles, gain skills while awake, and battle dream monsters to find out what happened to your dead brother.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35974395/3621f3394d111a89d38c075a516cb79e0a8c997a.gif[/img]

[h3]Deep Sleep: Labyrinth of the Forsaken is a standalone entry into the cult classic Deep Sleep series coming later in 2024!  Wishlist now![/h3]

notes.title: The best horror games to put the spooks up you this Halloween
notes.notes:
It’s Halloween! We’ve put the Hivemind Of Horror into a spooky jar of bubbling green liquid, and it’ll be pumping horror-themed articles onto the site today.

Halloween didn t really used to be that big of a deal in the UK, back when I were a kid. But now it is, so most people go to Halloween parties, or spooky club nights, or some other similar kind of terrifying celebration. I like to keep things traditional though, which means staying in on October 31st and kicking back with some Video Game Entertainment. Also I m COO of The NoSleep Podcast, and since we ve been working on Halloween content since around July, I think I deserve a break by the time it hits October s end.

So if, like me, you re after some video game recommendations in order to spend Halloween night alone, or even something to play after the festivities, then look no further. I ve compiled a list of thirteen (ooh) of the best horror games to be had this year.

notes.title: Deep Sleep Trilogy is LIVE
notes.notes:
[h1]Wake up! You have to wake up![/h1]
It all started in 2012 with [i]Deep Sleep[/i], a Jayisgame’s 10th Casual Game Design Competition winner. A game about being stuck in a nightmare dream was then followed by [i]Deeper Sleep[/i] in 2013 and [i]The Deepest Sleep[/i] in 2014.
Now you can own all the [b]3 titles gathered in one game[/b] on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35974395/cd116a4c0a2675fbd3249356aa52ad63e43396bd.gif[/img]

I'd like to thank each and every fan that supported me throughout the years, making this a wonderful and worthwhile journey. 

[i]Deep Sleep Trilogy[/i] is available as a single purchase for $4.99 or your regional equivalent.
Want more? Check out other games that I've created and buy them all in a bundle at a cheaper price! If you own some of the games, the price will be adjusted accordingly!
